title: 16. Who Hid the Doll?
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Something had happened in the Rainbow Class pretend-play corner! The baby doll that was always there had disappeared. Where's the baby doll? Hori, Kongi, and Bori looked around with wide eyes.
Then Dubu stepped forward, raising a magnifying glass and sniffing with that black nose. Detective Dubu will solve this case! Woof! Dubu sniffed and carefully examined the floor.

First, Dubu asked Bori. What were you playing? I've only been building with blocks. I didn't play in the pretend-play corner. Bori pointed to a big block tower. Dubu wrote in a notebook. Bori, the block builder. All clear!
Next came Kongi. Where were you? I was busy collecting acorns! Look, a whole basket! Kongi shook the basket, and Dubu wrote again. Kongi, the acorn collector. All clear!
Then Dubu asked Hori. What about you? I was racing my car! I didn't even see the baby doll. Hori rolled the red car with a vroom. Dubu nodded. Hori is clear, too! Then who could it be?
Dubu sniffed again. What's this smell? A single red thread lay on the floor. It had come from someone's red scarf. Dubu's eyes sparkled. A clue! Woof!
Dubu followed the scent quietly. Sniff, sniff. Those steps stopped in front of a big box in the corner. Rustling sounds came from behind it. The person we're looking for is in here!
Dubu gently lifted the box. Inside was Toto, curled up and hugging the baby doll! A red scarf peeked out. It was Toto! The friends gathered around.
Toto lowered their head. I'm sorry. I wanted to play pretend with you, too. But I was afraid you wouldn't let me join, so I hid the doll. Tears filled Toto's eyes. Now the friends understood.

Dubu patted Toto's shoulder. Instead of hiding it, just say, Let's play together! You're always welcome. Really? Toto's face lit up. Everyone sat together and played pretend. If there's something you want to say, you can say it out loud.
